---
title: "Baseball Through the Numbers"
---

Using the Lahman database, this site explores Major League Baseball's home-run history. Comparing home runs per team-game makes seasons of different lengths easier to compare; the rate varies across baseball history, with shortened seasons marked for context.

The career-leader analysis puts Barry Bonds at the top with 762 home runs, and his season-by-season chart shows how his total accumulated. Use the analysis pages in the navbar to explore the home-run trends and player charts.
